message.content:
Yes—if you’re experiencing excessive noise in Atlanta, you can file a complaint with the City of Atlanta’s authorities. Here’s how: | Step | What to Do | Where/How | |------|------------|-----------| | **1. Identify the source** | Determine whether the noise is coming from a residential building, commercial property, construction site, or public event. | — | | **2. Check the noise ordinance** | Atlanta’s Noise Ordinance (Title 10, Chapter 5) sets limits on permissible sound levels and quiet hours (typically 10 p.m.–7 a.m.). | [City of Atlanta Noise Ordinance](https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/public-safety/department-of-public-safety) | | **3. File a complaint** | • **Online**: Use the City of Atlanta’s “Noise Complaint” portal.
• **Phone**: Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non-emergency line at **404‑656‑4000**.
• **In person**: Visit the Atlanta Police Department’s main office at 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30309. | Online portal link: https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/public-safety/department-of-public-safety/noise-complaints | | **4. Provide details** | • Your name and contact info (optional but helpful).
• Address of the noisy location.
• Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs).
• Time and duration of the disturbance. | — | | **5. Follow up** | After filing, the police will investigate. If the noise violates the ordinance, they may issue a warning or citation. | — | ### Quick Tips - **Quiet Hours**: In most residential areas, noise is prohibited between 10 p.m. and 7 a.m. During the day, the limit is typically 70 dB(A) for residential zones and 80 dB(A) for commercial zones. - **Construction**: Construction noise is allowed only during business hours (8 a.m.–5 p.m.) unless otherwise permitted by a special permit. - **Public Events**: Noise from public events may require a special permit; check the city’s event permit requirements. If you’re unsure whether your situation falls under the noise ordinance, you can call the Atlanta Police Department’s non-emergency line for guidance before filing.
